trigger: Ambient: a crank radio in the ration line. Plays once.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: ...this is KD0LOU, Proctor, still here. Day nineteen. Good morning, Twin Ports.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: A fellow in Thunder Bay says transformer ships are loading in Busan. Hold onto that.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: FEMA has trucks in Saint Paul. That's what I hear. I hear a lot of things.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Be good to each other in that line. Weather: flurries, minus four. Lou out.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man near you snorts. 'Busan. Sure.' A woman shushes him. She wants the ships.
